title: scrape_scopes
description: Scheduled KiwiHouseSitters search scope. The scheduler reads these rows to decide which searches are due.

name.description: Stable scope identifier used by code and logs.

enabled.description: Whether this scope should be considered by the scheduler.

interval_minutes.description: Desired interval between successful runs. A scope is due when now - last_success_at is greater than or equal to this value.

missing_threshold_runs.description: Number of successful relevant scrapes that can miss a listing before the listing becomes missing_confirmed. This is per scope because 6 Auckland Central runs means about 30 minutes, while 3 All NZ runs means about 3 days.

site_filter.description: KiwiHouseSitters search filters for this scope.

last_attempt_at.description: Most recent time this exact configured scope issued a scrape attempt, regardless of success.

last_success_at.description: Most recent complete successful coverage time, either from this exact scope or a broader successful containing scope. Scheduler due checks use this field, not last_attempt_at, so failed runs do not make data look fresh.
